library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(msigdbr)






# 11.1. Import data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"


# Import full VST matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_oof.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F,
  row.names=1
)

# Convert rownames (ENSG) to a column and map to gene symbols
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )

# Import metadata
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import microbe reports
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "microbe_reports_bgfilter.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Load new metadata with mNGS hits
metadata_with_mNGS <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    raw_data_dir,
    "metadata_JCI_mNGS_hits_added_06122026.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# Import protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data/protein_mat.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 11.2. Select IFN plots


# Ensure same patients are used
microbe_reports_bgfilter <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    sample_name %in% metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name
  )

# Filter to viruses only
virus_reports <- microbe_reports_bgfilter %>%
  filter(
    category == "viruses"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name = factor(
      sample_name,
      levels = metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_name)

# Run by sum viral rpm
viral_rpm_df <- virus_reports %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  summarize(
    viral_rpm = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm=T),
    .groups="drop"
  )

# Add back all patients
viral_rpm_df <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_name,
    LRTI_adjudication
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    viral_rpm_df,
    by="sample_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    viral_rpm = ifelse(
      is.na(viral_rpm),
      0,
      viral_rpm
    )
  )

# Restrict to samples with viral mNGS hits
samples_with_viral_hits <- metadata_with_mNGS %>%
  filter(
    LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name,
    starts_with("JCI_virus_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=starts_with("JCI_virus_"),
    values_to="pathogen",
    values_drop_na=TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pathogen != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sanitized_name
  ) %>%
  distinct()






# 11.2a. Select Gene IFNs


ifn_genes <- c(
  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3"
)

rna_ifn_long <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% ifn_genes
  ) %>%

ifn_rna_df <- rna_ifn_long %>%

# Restrict to Definite LRTI with viral mNGS hits only
ifn_rna_df_definite <- ifn_rna_df %>%

  )






# 11.2b. Select Protein IFNs

  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3"
)

protein_ifn_long <- protein_mat %>%
  { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)
  ) %>%

    patient_id,

  pivot_longer(

  mutate(

  left_join(

# 11.2c. Combine RNA/Protein

    dplyr::select(

# 11.2d. Viral RPM vs IFN plot

# Build IFN score for a given set of sample RPM values
build_ifn_score <- function(rpm_df) {

  bind_rows(

    # RNA
    full_vsd %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% hallmark_ifn_genes
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol),
        names_to="sample_name",
        values_to="expr"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="RNA"
      ),

    # Protein
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols=-patient_id,
        names_to="gene_symbol",
        values_to="expr_log2"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in%
          intersect(
            hallmark_ifn_genes,
            colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
          )
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata_df_with_folds %>%
          dplyr::select(
            patient_id,
            sample_name
          ),
        by="patient_id"
      ) %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(
        expr_scaled=as.numeric(
          scale(expr_log2)
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(
        IFN_score=mean(
          expr_scaled,
          na.rm=T
        ),
        .groups="drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        modality="Protein"
      )

  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      rpm_df,
      by="sample_name"
    )
}

build_pathogen_rpm <- function(metadata_df, pathogen_prefix, report_df, report_category, synonyms=list()) {

  sample_pathogen_map <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(LRTI_adjudication == "Definite") %>%
    dplyr::select(sanitized_name, starts_with(pathogen_prefix)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=starts_with(pathogen_prefix), values_to="pathogen", values_drop_na=TRUE) %>%
    filter(pathogen != "") %>%
    dplyr::select(sanitized_name, pathogen) %>%
    distinct()

  match_pathogen_to_name <- function(pathogen, name) {
    p <- tolower(pathogen); n <- tolower(name)
    direct <- grepl(p, n, fixed=TRUE) | grepl(n, p, fixed=TRUE)
    syn <- if (p %in% names(synonyms)) grepl(synonyms[[p]], n, fixed=TRUE) else FALSE
    direct | syn
  }

  candidate_rows <- report_df %>%
    filter(category %in% report_category, sample_name %in% sample_pathogen_map$sanitized_name)

  matched_rows <- sample_pathogen_map %>%
    left_join(candidate_rows, by=c("sanitized_name"="sample_name"), relationship="many-to-many") %>%
    filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(is_match = match_pathogen_to_name(pathogen, name)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(is_match)

  unmatched <- sample_pathogen_map %>% anti_join(matched_rows, by=c("sanitized_name","pathogen"))
  if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
    print(unmatched)
    warning(nrow(unmatched), " sample-pathogen pairs unmatched — check synonyms list")
  }

  matched_rows %>%
    distinct(sanitized_name, name, nt_rpm) %>%
    group_by(sanitized_name) %>%
    summarize(rpm = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    dplyr::rename(sample_name = sanitized_name)
}

# Helper function: compute correlations
compute_cor <- function(
  score_df,
  rpm_col="viral_rpm"
) {

  score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      n_obs=n(),
      pearson_r=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(
            .data[[rpm_col]] + 1
          ),
          method="pearson"
        )$estimate
      } else {
        NA
      },
      pearson_p=if(
        n() >= 3
      ) {
        cor.test(
          IFN_score,
          log10(
            .data[[rpm_col]] + 1
          ),
          method="pearson"
        )$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      },
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj=p.adjust(
        pearson_p,
        method="BH"
      ),
      pearson_padj_fmt=signif(
        pearson_padj,
        2
      ),
      y_pos=case_when(
        modality=="RNA" ~ -1.3,
        modality=="Protein" ~ -1.5
      )
    )
}


# Helper function: make plot
make_ifn_plot <- function(
  score_df,
  cor_df,
  interaction_p,
  n_cases,
  x_label,
  title,
  subtitle,
  filename
) {

  p <- ggplot(
    score_df,
    aes(
      x=log10(viral_rpm + 1),
      y=IFN_score,
      color=modality
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      alpha=0.7,
      size=1.8
    ) +

    geom_smooth(
      method="lm",
      se=TRUE,
      alpha=0.15
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept=0,
      linetype="dashed",
      color="grey40"
    ) +

    # Correlation information
    geom_text(
      data=cor_df,
      aes(
        x=0.15,
        y = 2.05 - (seq_along(modality) - 1) * 0.30,
        label=paste0(
          modality,
          ": r = ",
          formatC(
            pearson_r,
            format="f",
            digits=2
          )
        )
      ),
      inherit.aes=FALSE,
      size=14 / 2.845,
      hjust=0
    ) +

    # Interaction p-value
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 1.60,
      label=ifelse(
        interaction_p < 0.001,
        "Interaction p < 0.001",
        paste0(
          "Interaction p = ",
          formatC(
            interaction_p,
            format="e",
            digits=2
          )
        )
      ),
      size=14 / 2.845,
      hjust=0
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim=c(0, 5),
      ylim=c(-2, 2),
      clip="off"
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks=seq(0, 5, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks=seq(-2, 2, 1),
      labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values=omics_colors
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_size=12,
      base_family="Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=12,
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      axis.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        color="black",
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.position= c(0.5, 0.08),
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        face="plain"
      ),
      legend.title=element_blank(),
      plot.title=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        size=16,
        hjust=0.5,
        face="plain"
      ),
      plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      x=x_label,
      y="IFN alpha pathway score (z-score)",
      title=title
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      filename
    ),
    p,
    width=6.5,
    height=6.5,
    device=cairo_pdf,
    bg="white"
    )

   return(p)
  }

# 11.3a. Viral load vs IFN - ALL VIRAL mNGS HITS (n=62 Definite)


virus_synonyms <- list("respiratory syncytial virus" = "orthopneumovirus")

viral_all_hits <- build_pathogen_rpm(
  metadata_df = metadata_with_mNGS,
  pathogen_prefix = "JCI_virus_",
  report_df = microbe_reports_bgfilter,
  report_category = "viruses",
  synonyms = virus_synonyms
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(viral_rpm = rpm)

message("11.3a - n samples with viral hits: ", nrow(viral_all_hits))





ifn_score_viral_all <- build_ifn_score(
  viral_all_hits
)

cor_viral_all <- compute_cor(
  ifn_score_viral_all
)

interaction_p_viral_all <- summary(
  lm(
    IFN_score ~

# 11.4. Composite neutrophil degranulation score — bacterial setup


neut_geneset <- msigdbr(
  species="Homo sapiens",
  collection="C2",
  subcollection="CP:REACTOME"
) %>%
  filter(
    gs_name %in% c("REACTOME_NEUTROPHIL_DEGRANULATION")
  ) %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

hallmark_neut_genes <- intersect(neut_geneset, full_vsd$gene_symbol)

cat("Neutrophil degranulation genes in RNA data:", length(hallmark_neut_genes), "\n")
cat("Neutrophil degranulation genes in protein data:",
    sum(hallmark_neut_genes %in% colnames(protein_mat)[-1]), "\n")

hallmark_neut_genes_shared <- intersect(hallmark_neut_genes, colnames(protein_mat)[-1])

cat("Shared neutrophil degranulation genes (RNA and protein):",
    length(hallmark_neut_genes_shared), "\n")


build_neut_score <- function(rpm_df) {
  bind_rows(
    full_vsd %>%
      filter(gene_symbol %in% hallmark_neut_genes) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols=-c(gene, gene_symbol), names_to="sample_name", values_to="expr") %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr))) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(Neut_score=mean(expr_scaled, na.rm=T), .groups="drop") %>%
      mutate(modality="RNA"),

    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(patient_id=as.integer(patient_id)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols=-patient_id, names_to="gene_symbol", values_to="expr_log2") %>%
      filter(gene_symbol %in% intersect(hallmark_neut_genes, colnames(protein_mat)[-1])) %>%
      left_join(metadata_df_with_folds %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, sample_name), by="patient_id") %>%
      group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
      mutate(expr_scaled=as.numeric(scale(expr_log2))) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(sample_name) %>%
      summarize(Neut_score=mean(expr_scaled, na.rm=T), .groups="drop") %>%
      mutate(modality="Protein")
  ) %>%
    inner_join(rpm_df, by="sample_name")
}



# Generalized correlation


compute_cor2 <- function(score_df, score_col, rpm_col="bacterial_rpm") {
  score_df %>%
    group_by(modality) %>%
    summarize(
      n_obs=n(),
      pearson_r=if(n() >= 3) cor.test(.data[[score_col]], log10(.data[[rpm_col]]+1), method="pearson")$estimate else NA,
      pearson_p=if(n() >= 3) cor.test(.data[[score_col]], log10(.data[[rpm_col]]+1), method="pearson")$p.value else NA,
      .groups="drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pearson_padj=p.adjust(pearson_p, method="BH"),
      pearson_padj_fmt=signif(pearson_padj, 2)
    )
}

make_neut_plot <- function(score_df, cor_df, interaction_p, n_cases, x_label, title, filename) {

  p <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x=log10(bacterial_rpm + 1), y=Neut_score, color=modality)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE, alpha=0.15) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    geom_text(
      data=cor_df,
      aes(x=0.15, y=2.05 - (seq_along(modality)-1)*0.30,
          label=paste0(modality, ": r = ", formatC(pearson_r, format="f", digits=2))),
      inherit.aes=FALSE, size=14/2.845, hjust=0
    ) +
    annotate("text", x=0.15, y=1.60,
      label=ifelse(interaction_p < 0.001, "Interaction p < 0.001",
                    paste0("Interaction p = ", formatC(interaction_p, format="e", digits=2))),
      size=14/2.845, hjust=0
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 5), ylim=c(-2, 2), clip="off") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 5, 1), labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 2, 1), labels=function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=omics_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size=12, base_family="Arial") +
    theme(
      text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12, face="plain"),
      axis.text=element_text(family="Arial", size=16, color="black", face="plain"),
      axis.title=element_text(family="Arial", size=16, color="black", face="plain"),
      legend.position=c(0.5, 0.08),
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.text=element_text(family="Arial", size=16, face="plain"),
      legend.title=element_blank(),
      plot.title=element_text(family="Arial", size=16, hjust=0.5, face="plain"),
      plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(x=x_label, y="Neutrophil degranulation score (z-score)", title=title)

  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, filename), p, width=6.5, height=6.5, device=cairo_pdf, bg="white")
  return(p)
}
